name: Columns with no description
description: Visible columns should have a description to assist users.

name: Numeric columns visible
description: Numeric columns should generally be hidden and aggregated via measures, unless they are specific attributes (e.g., Year).
expression: object.get('dataType', '') in ['int64', 'double', 'decimal'] and not object.get('isHidden', False) and 'id' not in object.get('name', '').lower() and 'year' not in object.get('name', '').lower()

name: Unused columns in model
description: Columns present in the model but not used in any visual report (Measure Killer logic).

name: Measures with no description
description: Measures should have a description detailing their logic.

name: Date column not marked as Date Table
description: Tables containing date logic should be marked as Date tables.
expression: any(c.get('dataType') == 'dateTime' for c in object.get('columns', [])) and not object.get('dataCategory') == 'Time'
